activity_summary: At the reckoning John Heminges set your share at twenty-two shillings, a pound and two shillings, in silver. You counted them and were not short. The gown's fifty shillings stayed unpaid, and Edith's eight stayed unpaid. Neither was taken out of the twenty-two. The Queen's twenty pounds were not in the room. The coffer was not brought down. No new stock was written. Your twopence to the carrier stayed out of the company book. The K still had no figure. Margery Pell had no receipt for the Rose's Tasso. Nothing was bought. You did not send the letter with the silver.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted twenty-two shillings and refused to pay either debt with them.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named the share, left both debts standing, and did not bring the coffer down.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Kept the K without a digit and refused a new stock figure.

entities.name: Goodwife Margery Pell
entities.context: Reported her own stair and brought no Rose receipt.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Asked after his lines, stayed on you, and got no number.

facets.activity: Took twenty-two shillings at the reckoning

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Your share, William, is twenty-two shillings.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: The fifty stands. Edith's eight stands.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A pound, and two shillings. I have them.
